description: Land Title Settlement Department - Karamada,Udunuwara D/S Division, Mahanuwara District - Cad. Map No. 320249
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring the determination of land titles for specific parcels (Nos. 284, 286, 287, 288) in Karamada village. It includes detailed land particulars such as parcel numbers, extent, owner names, identity card numbers, and title classifications. This falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) as it concerns land registration and property ownership matters without any government personnel changes or structural administrative modifications.
